title: PDEA declares nearly 200 South Cotabato barangays ‘drug-cleared’

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) has declared close to 200 barangays in South Cotabato as “drug-cleared,” but sustaining these gains remains a challenge amid continuing concerns over illegal drug activities, officials said. Investigator Agent V Brenda Joy Pollisco, PDEA South Cotabato provincial officer, said the agency continues to monitor communities to prevent the entry and spread of illegal drugs. During a recent town hall meeting in Barangay Paraiso here, Pollisco said the province is not among the areas classified as severely affected by illegal drugs.
